name: admission-webhook image
description: Distroless container image for the admission-webhook service; built via make docker-build-admission-webhook. Registry/tag/digest are operator-supplied (chart is registry-agnostic; pinning addressed in P6).

name: policy-manager image
description: Distroless container image for the policy-manager service; built via make docker-build-policy-manager. Registry/tag/digest operator-supplied (P6).

name: dashboard image
description: Distroless container image for the dashboard BFF (embeds AST-SPA); built via make docker-dashboard (requires ui-build). Registry/tag/digest operator-supplied (P6).

name: admission-webhook
protocols: HTTPS TLS 1.3 (server-auth only) on 8443; HTTP (unauthenticated) on 9090
description: Validating/mutating admission controller serving /validate and /mutate (AdmissionReview). Embeds AST-OPA. 9090 exposes Prometheus metrics. Source: cmd/admission-webhook/main.go.

name: policy-manager
protocols: HTTP REST /api/v1 (unauthenticated) on 8080; HTTP (unauthenticated) metrics on 9091
description: Policy/PolicyException lifecycle, decision intake, CRD reconcile with leader election. Embeds AST-OPA. Source: cmd/policy-manager/main.go.

name: dashboard BFF
protocols: HTTP (no user authn; write-gated by ALLOW_WRITES) on 8090; HTTP (unauthenticated) metrics on 9092
description: Backend-for-frontend serving AST-SPA plus /api and reverse-proxy /api/v1 to AST-PM:8080. Read-only unless ALLOW_WRITES=true. Source: cmd/dashboard/main.go.

name: Svelte dashboard SPA
description: Single-page application embedded in the dashboard image and served by AST-DB. Source: web/, cmd/dashboard/web_embed.go.

name: OPA/Rego policy evaluator
description: OPA/Rego evaluation engine compiled into AST-WH and AST-PM (not a separately deployed component). Source: internal/policy/engine.go.

name: Policy CRD
description: Namespaced CustomResourceDefinition policies.policies.kube-policies.io (kind Policy, version v1). Stored by kube-apiserver. Source: deployments/kubernetes/crds/policies.yaml.

name: PolicyException CRD
description: Namespaced CustomResourceDefinition policyexceptions.policies.kube-policies.io (kind PolicyException, version v1). Stored by kube-apiserver. Source: deployments/kubernetes/crds/policyexceptions.yaml.

name: Helm chart (RBAC/Services/Config)
description: Helm chart kube-policies (appVersion 1.0.0) deploying all in-boundary workloads, RBAC, Services, ConfigMap, and TLS material into namespace kube-policies-system. Source: charts/kube-policies/.

name: kube-apiserver
description: Cluster Kubernetes API server in ZONE-EXT. Calls AST-WH:8443 (ICX-01), stores CRDs, and is reconciled by AST-PM (ICX-06). Provided and operated by the customer/CSP; outside the authorization boundary (inherited platform service).

name: Prometheus
description: Metrics scraper in ZONE-EXT pulling :9090/:9091/:9092 (ICX-03). Operator-supplied; the chart can optionally bundle a Prometheus subchart, but the scraping platform is treated as external to the authorization boundary.
